news.title: BOBCARD Eterna: no joining fee for now
news.desc: Bank of Baroda's premium Eterna card is being offered without a joining fee during the current offer. Reports differ on whether the waiver covers only the first year, so check the final terms when you apply.

news.title: BOBCARD Etihad Guest: bigger welcome miles
news.desc: New customers can earn up to 15,000 bonus miles on the Premium card and up to 7,500 on the standard card, by spending ₹25,000 and then ₹50,000. The offer runs until 15 November 2026.

news.title: Amex Platinum lounges now spend-linked
news.desc: From 1 October, domestic lounge access needs ₹1 lakh of eligible spend in the previous calendar quarter, for up to two visits.

news.title: Air India and IHG team up on Maharaja Club
news.desc: Maharaja Club members earn 3X points on eligible IHG stays until 31 December 2026, and IHG points can be converted into Maharaja Points.

news.title: Amex Reward Xcelerator reaches India
news.desc: Platinum and Centurion cardholders earn 10X to 20X Membership Rewards points at selected luxury, dining and travel partners, with no cap. Platinum Reserve gets 5X. The offer is valid until 31 January 2027.

news.title: Bank shopping portals now cover HDFC, ICICI and Axis
news.desc: HDFC SmartBuy, ICICI iShop Rewards 360 and Axis Grab Deals all pay extra points on partner brands when you shop through the portal. Compare the portal rate with the card's normal rate before you buy.

news.title: HSBC waives forex markup until 31 October
news.desc: Existing HSBC cardholders, including add-on cards, pay no forex markup on overseas and foreign-currency spends between 15 August and 31 October 2026. ATM withdrawals and GST are not covered.

news.title: Apple Pay goes live with Axis Visa cards
news.desc: Axis Bank Visa credit cards can now be added to Apple Wallet on iPhone and Apple Watch, for use in shops, online and in apps. Axis is the only issuer supported so far.

news.title: SBI Card's ETERNAL co-brand spotted
news.desc: A new ETERNAL SBI Card has appeared on SBI Card's site with 10% off non-grocery spends at Zomato, District and Blinkit, plus a monthly movie offer. Fees and the launch date are not announced yet.

news.title: Visa Power Travel offer widens
news.desc: From 1 October, eligible Visa cards earn the extra reward on all overseas destinations outside India, with a milestone bonus of up to ₹10,000.

news.title: Axis EDGE transfer partners overhauled
news.desc: Accor returns at 2:1 for Atlas. Cathay, Miles & More and Hilton Honors were added, and ITC Hotels was removed. Marriott has not returned. Air India, Flying Blue and Qantas moved to a lower yearly cap.

news.title: Amex Platinum Travel milestones cut again
news.desc: The ₹1.9 lakh milestone bonus is gone, and the ₹7 lakh milestone now gives a ₹20,000 Taj e-gift card in place of 22,500 points.

news.title: IDFC FIRST: zero forex, but no points abroad from 26 October
news.desc: The zero forex markup that started on 9 September comes with a trade-off. From 26 October 2026, overseas spends on the zero-markup cards stop earning reward points. Ashva and IndiGo keep earning and keep their current markup.

news.title: IDFC FIRST moves to zero forex markup
news.desc: Foreign currency transactions on IDFC FIRST credit cards no longer carry a markup. Earlier it was 1.5% to 3.5%.

news.title: Axis premium cards lose domestic Priority Pass
news.desc: Priority Pass is no longer accepted at domestic lounges in India. DCC markup rises to 2% on Magnus, and tolls and gift cards stop earning rewards.

news.title: Amex transfer ratios improve
news.desc: Membership Rewards points now convert to more Hilton Honors and Virgin Atlantic points.

news.title: Axis Bank fee and reward changes, 2026
news.desc: From 28 August the currency-conversion markup rises to 3.5% on most cards (1.8% on Olympus, 2% on Magnus) and late fees go up to ₹1,200 or ₹1,300. Select's extra lounge and golf milestone stops counting excluded spends from 1 October, and Priority Pass and club renewals need your consent from 15 November.

news.title: HSBC TravelOne ends chauffeur transfers
news.desc: Complimentary airport chauffeur transfers have ended, and the HSBC forex cashback offer expired, so the full 3.5% forex markup applies.

news.title: HSBC Live+ upgraded to Visa Infinite
news.desc: The 10% cashback now covers shopping and utilities, the monthly cap rises to ₹1,200, and one international lounge visit a year is added. Domestic lounge visits fall from 4 to 2.

news.title: HDFC Infinia SmartBuy voucher cap
news.desc: Accelerated points on GyFTR and Woohoo vouchers are capped at 3,000 a month. Flights (5X) and hotels (10X) are unaffected.
